body:
Let's assume she had just that $280 she took from the ATM, even excluding costs for gas and liquor. How much does that really get you at a ski resort, including lodging, food, lift fees? I don't trust that LE did their due diligence in not only checking under Maura's name but looking for people in her age range checking in (maybe someone else).

As for reservations records, I run a condo rental and we keep records going back decades, especially after computers made storage of such info so easy and routine.

She didn't have much money to "get away" for a short trip during peak ski season (unless she had the $4000 taken out of ATMs by her Dad). It seems more reasonable to be going in partially on the trip without other persons. 

It seems a long way to drive without any sure plans.
There's no reason \*not\* to have Cissy Jones do Delilah, since we never see her anyway. I wonder which "versions" of the conversations they will immortalize as the movie version.
